rows = [np.mean(row == line) > threshold for row in grid]
columns = [np.mean(column == line) > threshold for column in grid.T]
rationale: Identify gray grid lines by their majority density, restore their full extent, erase scattered markers, and place the input's remaining color at every horizontal and vertical intersection. Tensor values control background, line color, and detection threshold.
